name: TK_AVAILABLE
meaning: idle loop anim 0; answers msg 2 with 0x1E and accepts msg 1

name: TK_RINGING
meaning: anim 1 -> anim 2 + looping sound 0xF8 -> anim 3, advanced when each anim finishes

name: TK_COLLECTED
meaning: idle loop anim 0; set at init when the level's Progress bit is already set, or at the end of the sequence
